recall.question: Each shoe is 11 cm wide at the toe and 5 cm at the heel. How wide is the pair packed toe-to-heel?
recall.why: Reversing one shoe puts a wide toe beside a narrow heel: 11 + 5 = 16 cm, against 11 + 11 = 22 cm with toes together. Neither shoe shrank; the widest section did.
